about_the_game:
Our planet is already at full capacity.

This is not a statement of natural geography,

but a sociological one.

As old ways of life crumble

and cities exert their gravitational pull,

the land no longer fit for human habitation

has indeed continued to grow.

Behind the grandeur of industrial production

lies a factory line whose true product is waste—

be it the refuse that resists disposal,

or the surplus of those who are no longer required.

Yet, the land once thought vast enough to contain them

has vanished from this planet.

In response to this problem,

gravity was reversed.

Like the metabolism of a body,

we periodically export the by-products of modernity to the “outer world.”

As long as modernity remains a privilege,

this cycle will never end.

Since then,

our souls have been in exile under the force of gravity.

Key Features

  • Surreal Worldview
    The story unfolds in an inverted world where the sky and ground have traded places. Retro electronic illustrations and a distinctive writing style immerse you in a realm that is grotesque, absurd, terrifying — yet strangely humorous.

  • Exploration System
    Blending exploration and survival, the game’s core loop is built around three systems: passive encounters, active discoveries, and goal-driven missions. One moment you may be ambushed by a rogue machine; the next, you’re scavenging a crashed starship brimming with resources — and clues to the world’s hidden truth.
    Through these intertwined systems, the game seeks to simulate an unforgettable journey shaped by your choices and the events you encounter.

  • Rich Encounters & Branching Choices
    The world offers a vast array of random events and branching storylines. You may choose to aid others, communicate peacefully, spare a defeated enemy out of honor or pity — or act as a conqueror, clearing all resistance in your path.
    “Moral” and “immoral” actions rarely bring immediate consequence, especially when no one is watching... Yet, a single careless decision may ripple across the world in ways you never intended.

  • Combat System
    Combat follows a tactical grid-based format, enhanced with an innovative “Reformed Turn-Based” mechanic — balancing strategic depth with real-time tension.
    There is no fixed path of progression: players are encouraged to experiment freely with modules, weapons, and builds. Development outside of battle forms a major part of the gameplay loop.

  • Deep Build & Customization System
    Freedom of construction lies at the heart of the game. Roguelike-style random enhancements coexist with crafting and progression systems that feature clear unlock conditions.
    Tailor your strategy to your current modifiers or personal preference: overwhelm enemies with numbers, command an elite unit, favor mobility or formation tactics.
    Technology, tactics, equipment, and aesthetic choices all determine the true strength of your forces.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all audiences.
It includes strong language and profanity, sexual innuendo and references, and depictions of violence and other sensitive topics.It also touches on themes of psychological distress and self-harm.
Player discretion is advised.

short_description: The sky lies beneath our feet.Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun.This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.
